title: Majoon Ushba alleviated IL-17A sensitized keratinocyte ferroptosis via JAK-2-STAT-3 signaling axis and reversed imiquimod induced psoriasiform inflammation.
authors: Rithvik, Arulkumaran; Bhattacharjee, Shangomitra; Illanad, Gouri H; Kumar, Pawan; Javed, Ghazala; Karwasra, Ritu; Ahmed, Zaheer; Rasool, Mahaboobkhan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究多草药制剂Majoon Ushba通过JAK-2-STAT-3信号轴缓解银屑病角质细胞铁死亡，仅含少量小分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: CONTEXT: Psoriasis is a relapsing autoimmune disease exacerbated by aberrant interleukin (IL)-17 A activity. Majoon Ushba, a unani polyherbal formulation implicated in clinical cases of psoriasis lacks immunopharmacological validation. OBJECTIVE: The study aims to investigate the pre-clinical efficacy of Majoon Ushba and its therapeutic role in mitigating IL-17A-induced keratinocytes ferroptosis via ablation of JAK-2/STAT-3 pathway. MATERIALS AND METHODS: HaCaT cells were stimulated with IL-17A to assess the activation of the JAK-2-STAT-3 pathway. The STAT-3 inhibitor, S3I-201, was used to confirm the role of the STAT-3 axis in keratinocyte ferroptosis. Majoon Ushba pretreatment was assessed to determine its efficacy in alleviating keratinocyte ferroptosis. An imiquimod (IMQ)-induced psoriasis mouse model was used to evaluate the pre-clinical efficacy of Majoon Ushba. Furthermore, prior high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) profiling was leveraged for in-silico docking analysis to identify the binding affinities of key phytoconstituents with IL-17RA and STAT-3. RESULTS: Majoon Ushba alleviated the IL-17A/JAK-2-STAT-3 axis, improved GPX4 expression, and regulated lipid peroxidation. Subsequently, Majoon Ushba also reversed the expression of pathogenic mediators and led to a reduction in serum cytokine levels of IL-17A, IL-23, and IFN-gamma. An in-silico docking analysis suggested favorable binding affinities for key phytoconstituents of Majoon Ushba against IL-17RA and STAT-3. Aligned with pre-clinical and in vitro results, the computational findings offer initial evidence that the polyherbal formulation may influence the IL-17A/JAK-2-STAT-3 signaling pathway. DISCUSSION AND CONCLUSION: In conclusion, our preliminary findings reveal a plausible mechanistic basis for the anti-psoriatic efficacy of Majoon Ushba, warranting larger clinical trials in psoriasis patient cohorts.
abstract_zh: 背景：银屑病是一种复发性自身免疫性疾病，由异常的白细胞介素（IL）-17A活性加剧。Majoon Ushba，一种在银屑病临床病例中涉及的回医多草药制剂，缺乏免疫药理学验证。目的：本研究旨在探讨Majoon Ushba的临床前疗效及其通过消融JAK-2/STAT-3通路减轻IL-17A诱导的角质形成细胞铁死亡的治療作用。材料与方法：用IL-17A刺激HaCaT细胞以评估JAK-2-STAT-3通路的激活。使用STAT-3抑制剂S3I-201确认STAT-3轴在角质形成细胞铁死亡中的作用。评估Majoon Ushba预处理以确定其在减轻角质形成细胞铁死亡中的疗效。使用咪喹莫特（IMQ）诱导的银屑病小鼠模型评估Majoon Ushba的临床前疗效。此外，利用先前的高效液相色谱（HPLC）分析进行计算机模拟对接分析，以确定关键植物成分与IL-17RA和STAT-3的结合亲和力。结果：Majoon Ushba减轻了IL-17A/JAK-2-STAT-3轴，改善了GPX4表达，并调节了脂质过氧化。随后，Majoon Ushba还逆转了致病介质的表达，并导致血清细胞因子IL-17A、IL-23和IFN-γ水平降低。计算机模拟对接分析表明，Majoon Ushba的关键植物成分对IL-17RA和STAT-3具有有利的结合亲和力。与临床前和体外结果一致，计算发现提供了初步证据，表明该多草药制剂可能影响IL-17A/JAK-2-STAT-3信号通路。讨论与结论：总之，我们的初步发现揭示了Majoon Ushba抗银屑病疗效的合理机制基础，值得在银屑病患者队列中进行更大规模的临床试验。
